nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf holding token balances of all accounts in MarsShiba.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) allowance of transfer approvals.
Public uint totalSupply of the MarsShiba token.
Private address owner; privileged account controlling delegate and batchSend.
Public string name of the token.
Public string symbol of the token.
Constant public uint decimals set to 18.
msg.sender, attacker-controlled caller address used for authorization and accounting.
transfer(address,uint) payable that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom(address,address,uint) payable, guarded by ensure modifier, mutates allowance and balances with unchecked subtraction.
approve(address,uint) payable that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate(address,bytes) payable that requires msg.sender == owner then performs an arbitrary delegatecall.
batchSend(address[],uint) payable, owner-only, multiplies _value by array length and loops distributing balances.
Internal pure helper computing a Uniswap-style pair address from factory, tokenA and tokenB.
MarsShiba constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and initial balances/allowances.
Modifier ensure(address,address) that recomputes the UNI pair and restricts _from/_to to owner or the pair.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) executing arbitrary attacker- or owner-supplied code in contract context.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length in batchSend, vulnerable to integer overflow.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend.
Parameter _to of transfer().
Parameter _value of transfer().
Parameter _from of transferFrom().
Parameter _to of transferFrom().
Parameter _value of transferFrom().
Parameter a (delegatecall target address) of delegate().
Parameter b (delegatecall payload bytes) of delegate().
Parameter _tos array of recipient addresses of batchSend().
Parameter _value per-recipient amount of batchSend().
Local total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend().
Local loop variable _to inside the batchSend() for loop.

edges.reason: transfer() delegates all logic to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Externally callable transfer() derives the sender from msg.sender.
transferFrom() uses msg.sender for allowance and authorization checks.
approve() writes allowance keyed by msg.sender.
delegate() authorizes via require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() authorizes via require(msg.sender == owner).
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender, establishing privileged control.
transferFrom() is wrapped by the ensure modifier, which is resolved as a pre-execution callback.
ensure modifier computes the pair address by calling pairFor().
pairFor() returns the UNI pair address consumed by the ensure check.
transferFrom() mutates allowance[_from][msg.sender] with unchecked subtraction.
transferFrom() mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
transferFrom() performs the unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate() executes an arbitrary delegatecall, granting the owner full contract control.
The arbitrary delegatecall can re-enter and rewrite the balanceOf mapping.
The arbitrary delegatecall can re-enter and overwrite the owner state variable.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication.
batchSend() performs the unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total.
batchSend() credits balanceOf[_to] and debits balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath.
Constructor assigns the privileged owner state variable.
Constructor sets the deployer's initial balanceOf entry.
Constructor sets totalSupply from the _supply argument.
transfer() forwards its _to argument into transferFrom().
transfer() forwards its _value argument into transferFrom().
Parameter _from of transferFrom() selects the debited account.
Parameter _to of transferFrom() selects the credited account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom() drives allowance and balance arithmetic.
Parameter a supplies the delegatecall target address.
Parameter b supplies the delegatecall calldata payload.
Parameter _tos supplies the batchSend recipient array and loop length.
Parameter _value supplies the per-recipient amount in batchSend().
Local total is the product computed by the unchecked multiplication.
Local loop variable _to addresses each batchSend recipient.
Loop variable _to indexes the balanceOf credit in batchSend().

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to belongs directly to transfer() and is only used to forward into transferFrom().
Parameter _value belongs directly to transfer() and only forwards the transfer amount.
Parameter _from is the source account of transferFrom() and feeds its balance subtraction.
Parameter _to is the destination account of transferFrom() and feeds its balance addition.
Parameter _value drives allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom().
Parameter a is only used as the delegatecall target inside delegate().
Parameter b is only used as the delegatecall payload inside delegate().
Parameter _tos is only used for iteration and length in batchSend().
Parameter _value is only used for the multiplication and credit loop in batchSend().
Local total is defined by the unchecked _value * _tos.length multiplication.
Local _to is the loop cursor scoped to batchSend()'s for loop.
